dc_floor_ab.verdict: the relaxation admitted 61 extra fixtures that were worse on hit rate, loss rate and non-loss rate alike — it was buying volume, not accuracy

draw_risk.verdict: NO draw-risk cutoff reduces losses — every candidate is worse than doing nothing. Refusing nothing, the gate's 145 picks already sit at 9.0% loss / 91.0% non-loss. Refusing the 50% highest-draw-risk picks (73 fixtures) is the least harmful option at 9.7% loss, and the 30% cutoff (101 picks) is the most harmful at 10.9% loss — worse than the 9.0% baseline. Draw risk is not a defect to avoid: a draw is a NON-loss, so refusing draw-prone fixtures concentrates defeats rather than removing them.
